propositions: Destructive repair must use durable, provider-neutral pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate instead of GitHub-only gh workflow disable/enable
Repair must abort fail-closed if git user.email is missing, if a pre-existing pause exists, if pause CAS-write fails, or if the reconciler lock is held or corrupt
Pause cleanup must reread the pause document and OID as one snapshot, clear only if the reason matches the invocation token, and pass the observed OID to release without retry on CAS miss
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair must preserve public vocabulary, existing repair effects, and non-repair behavior while adopting the shared repair-owned pause contract
Missing or replaced pause during cleanup must surface as error without recreating or clearing another actor's pause, leaving the bridge paused for operator recovery
